what: Live-review wakes posted by the GitHub Actions runner (github-actions[bot]) fail to commit their review packet to live-review/rows. They show evidence_state could_not_commit, 'git data API commit failed', HTTP 403, on 2 of 2 runner-posted wakes on 11-22: run 44983021424 (04:04Z, pkg-81f9bcb22635415a, ada_pullback_2h, bybit_2) and run 45000914840 (08:09Z, pkg-cb689c1abaf44154, ml_entry XRPUSDT, bybit_2). The same slots posted from the VM path DID commit (7161ff762afe at 04:01Z, 895d7b3aec4a at 08:01Z). Likely cause: the runner token lacks write on that branch, or a branch rule blocks it. Nothing is lost while the VM path posts, but the runner path is a broken duplicate that wakes the manager twice. Fix options: give the runner write access to live-review/rows, or skip the runner post when the VM already posted that slot. Clears when a runner-posted wake shows evidence_state committed, or when the runner path is retired with a stated reason. Routed to after the 11-25 usage reset; do not fix during the throttle.
